positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed docker images for use with Kubernetes and Openshift clusters.

Applied security lockdowns for various technologies (JBoss, RHEL, Docker, Web Server, OAuth, etc)

Developed REST and SOAP service endpoints for AOC airspace data.

Developed service clients to interface with various AOC applications.

Developed data translators for airspace data in variety of formats.

Developed server and client side components for ACO parsing system.

Maintained legacy software for airspace manipulation.

Fielded helpdesk calls for legacy software support.

positions.title: Principal Cyber Engineer
positions.description:
Developed software to interface with low level functionality of windows phone 7/8 devices, such as the RIL (Radio Interface Layer) and the IP Helper API (for TCP packet transmission statistics).
 
Designed collection modules (file/directory retrieval, GPS information, disk space, memory usage, cell phone networking information, OS/firmware/.NET version, processing listing, etc.) for windows phone 7/8.

Developed a module management system to control various module functions.  This management system was responsible for installation, loading/unloading, validation, dependency resolution, and monitoring of modules as well as providing common logging, property sharing, event monitoring (inter module and system), and inter module messaging to all modules throughout the system.

Developed a customized web server to run on Windows Phone 7/8 devices to  provide functions not readily available on the device, such as file system access, registry manipulation, process management functions (task viewer, start/stop processes), certificate store access, and an automated testing environment.

Developed XML wrapper classes with built in encryption for Windows CE 6/7 devices.
Investigated avenues for deploying code to mobile devices, in addition to security features for the devices.

Developed several support applications such as a task viewer for the devices, package builders for phone updates, and automated deployment scripts for update packages.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed software to interface with streaming flight data, including multi-threaded data acquisition, parsing, encryption, and database storage.

Performed subversion admin duties such as repository migration and maintenance.
Modified existing code for various web applications using Google’s GWT library.

Deployed to various locations to perform domain admin duties; such as applying security patches for system lockdowns.

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description:
Developed APIs for electronic devices including cameras, GPS units, electronic compasses, thermostats, wireless relays, and DAQ devices.

Developed communication protocols and network architectures for distributed automous swarming agents.

Developed software to simulate hardware for UGVs, UAVs, PTZs, and UGSs.

Worked with Navy clients to develop software requirements and specifications as well as technical reports, system documentation, and test plans for various NAVAIR projects.

positions.title: Graduate Assistant
positions.description:
Taught microcontroller interfacing and assembly language labs.
Wrote software for automated acquisition and analysis of IR images.
Wrote software for controlling robots with PIC/HC12 microcontrollers.
Designed an Unmanned Ground Vehicle for analyzing bridge decks.

positions.title: Computer Engineer
positions.description:
Designed custom GUI applications for interfacing, monitoring, and controlling telemetric equipment.
Designed, installed, and operated telemetric monitoring systems.
Developed interfacing software for a variety of serial devices.

company.name: Naval Surface Warfare Center Dahlgren Division

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Wrote Doors DXL scripts to automate the importing of requirements documents for the International Space Station project
